import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1000;
    static final long LINF = 0x3F3F3F3F_FFFFFFFFL;
    static int N, M;
    static int[][] cap = new int[2002][2002];
    static List<Integer>[] gr = new ArrayList[2002];
    static boolean[] vis = new boolean[2002];
    static int[] parent = new int[2002];

    static int[][] ds = { {1,0}, {0,1}, {-1,0}, {0,-1} };

    static int augment(int u) {
        if (u == 1) return INF;
        vis[u] = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < gr[u].size(); i++) {
            int v = gr[u].get(i);
            if (!vis[v] && cap[u][v] > 0) {
                int r = augment(v);
                if (r > 0) {
                    parent[v] = u;
                    return Math.min(r, cap[u][v]);
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int maxflow() {
        int ans = 0;
        int flow;
        parent[0] = -1;
        do {
            ans += flow;
            Arrays.fill(vis, false);
            flow = augment(0);
            if (flow == 0) break;
            int v = 1;
            while (v != 0) {
                int u = parent[v];
                cap[u][v] -= flow;
                cap[v][u] += flow;
                v = u;
            }
        } while (flow > 0);
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int dim = sc.nextInt();
        int time_to_die = sc.nextInt();

        for (int i = 0; i < 2002; i++) {
            gr[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j < 2002; j++) {
                cap[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }

        String[] labsci = new String[dim];
        String[] labcap = new String[dim];

        int[][][] vert = new int[dim][dim][2];

        int malfunc = 0;
        int N_node = 2;

        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
            labsci[i] = sc.next();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
            labcap[i] = sc.next();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < dim; j++) {
                if (labsci[i].charAt(j) >= '1' && labsci[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    cap[0][N_node] = labsci[i].charAt(j) - '0';
                    gr[0].add(N_node);
                    gr[N_node].add(0);
                    vert[i][j][0] = N_node++;
                } else if (labsci[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    malfunc = 100 * i + j;
                    labsci[i] = labsci[i].substring(0, j) + 'Y' + labsci[i].substring(j+1);
                }
            }
        }

        M = N_node;
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < dim; j++) {
                if (labcap[i].charAt(j) >= '1' && labcap[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    cap[M][1] = labcap[i].charAt(j) - '0';
                    gr[M].add(1);
                    gr[1].add(M);
                    vert[i][j][1] = M++;
                }
            }
        }

        int[][] die = new int[dim][dim];
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++)
            Arrays.fill(die[i], time_to_die + 1);
        die[malfunc / 100][malfunc % 100] = 0;

        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(malfunc);
        int x, y, nx, ny;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            x = q.peek() / 100;
            y = q.peek() % 100; q.poll();

            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                nx = x + ds[i][0];
                ny = y + ds[i][1];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < dim && ny >= 0 && ny < dim && labsci[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y' && die[nx][ny] > die[x][y]+1) {
                    die[nx][ny] = die[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(100 * nx + ny);
                }
            }
        }

        int[][] reach = new int[dim][dim];

        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < dim; j++) {
                if (labsci[i].charAt(j) >= '1' && labsci[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    for (int r = 0; r < dim; r++) {
                        Arrays.fill(reach[r], time_to_die + 1);
                    }
                    reach[i][j] = 0;

                    if (labcap[i].charAt(j) >= '1' && labcap[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                        cap[vert[i][j][0]][vert[i][j][1]] = INF;
                        gr[vert[i][j][0]].add(vert[i][j][1]);
                        gr[vert[i][j][1]].add(vert[i][j][0]);
                    }

                    Queue<Integer> q2 = new LinkedList<>();
                    q2.offer(100 * i + j);
                    while (!q2.isEmpty()) {
                        int x2 = q2.peek() / 100;
                        int y2 = q2.peek() % 100; q2.poll();

                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                            int nx2 = x2 + ds[d][0];
                            int ny2 = y2 + ds[d][1];
                            if (nx2 >= 0 && nx2 < dim && ny2 >= 0 && ny2 < dim && labsci[nx2].charAt(ny2) != 'Y' && reach[nx2][ny2] > reach[x2][y2] + 1) {
                                if (labcap[nx2].charAt(ny2) >= '1' && labcap[nx2].charAt(ny2) <= '9') {
                                    if (reach[x2][y2] + 1 <= die[nx2][ny2]) {
                                        cap[vert[i][j][0]][vert[nx2][ny2][1]] = INF;
                                        gr[vert[i][j][0]].add(vert[nx2][ny2][1]);
                                        gr[vert[nx2][ny2][1]].add(vert[i][j][0]);
                                    }
                                }
                                if (reach[x2][y2] + 1 < die[nx2][ny2]) {
                                    reach[nx2][ny2] = reach[x2][y2] + 1;
                                    q2.offer(100 * nx2 + ny2);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(maxflow());
        sc.close();
    }
}
